title: Settings file
description: The settings both apps hold and trade (APP-25, docs/backend/settings.md): the Angular app exports and imports it, and so does `riftweave settings`. A key this schema does not name is kept on import and written back on export, so a round trip through either app loses nothing.

riftweave.description: What the file is, so a save or a character file is not taken for settings.

version.description: The file format; an app refuses a version it does not read.

theme.description: The colour mode (APP-23); the CLI maps it to its own colours.

modules.description: The enabled optional modules, by manifest id. Core is always loaded and is never listed.

mode.description: local (offline, the default), server (an API at server_url), or room (APP-17).

players_see_only_known.description: APP-29: players see only the monsters the GM revealed.
